clips.text: N'Djamena, Chad. Mahamat buys medicines for a hospital.
A new supplier sends him a beautiful price list… but no documents.
Mahamat, before you sign, ask for five documents.
One: the W-H-O format C-O-P-P. Two: the G-M-P certificate.
Three: stability data for hot, humid climates. Four: the registration dossier, where one exists.
Five: the manufacturer's batch certificate of analysis.
And check that the manufacturer's name matches on every page.
At Akuma Pharma, our team requests these from the manufacturer… and checks them.
Want the checklist? Send CHECKLIST to Akuma Pharma on WhatsApp.
Akuma Pharma… closer than you think.
